scenario_meta.description: A cliffside city taxes spoken promises by their weight, and couriers carry unpaid ones between households.
scenario_meta.simulation_objective: Balance civic solvency, acoustic taxation rates, and physical bridge stability against public unrest and communication collapse.
player_entry_points: Arrive as an audit-deputy assigned to inspect the overtaxed balance beams at the Excise Weigh-Beam Registry.
Descend into the Gantry Runners Bivouac as an out-of-work courier seeking lucrative defaulted promise routes.
Infiltrate the Undercleft Whisperer Exchange to negotiate low-density contracts for disenfranchised cliff clans.
Report to The Silence Assembly Mortar Basin as an apprentice tasked with handling hazardous breached vow powder.
creator_conflict_hooks: A massive multi-generation debt capsule has begun to crack open under sheer mass in the central registry, threatening to acoustically deafen nearby gantry lines.
The Acoustic Excise doubled transit surcharges overnight, prompting courier runners to threaten a total blockade of vow deliveries over the main gorge.
A black-market dialect developed in the Undercleft is completely evading acoustic weigh-scales, starving the civic wall mortar compounders of binding dust.
